vulnerability.explanation: On non-Windows, non-VMS builds, opt_path_end() can return filename-1 when the input is an empty string due to the pre-decrement loop. opt_progname() then calls strncpy(prog, p, sizeof(prog) - 1) at line 140 with p pointing before the buffer start, leading to an out-of-bounds read. Passing an empty string to opt_progname() triggers this.
